[RFCS.23.8] **Stored records across releases.** A stored `FactExternal` is
read unchanged within a release series ([LDET.1.10]). A release whose
`FactExternal` encoding or `Kind` set differs from the previous series' must ship
a migration that rewrites records of the previous series into its own; a
release that changes neither ships none. Migration keeps `asserted_at`, and
recomputes `schema_hash` for the schema it migrates to.

The store keeps each record opaque and never reads inside it ([LSTO.2.1]).
